author: TOI NEWS DESK
description: Union home minister Amit Shah declared Maoism's destructive nature, vowing its complete elimination from India by March 31. He urged Naxalites to surrender for rehabilitation, highlighting Chhattisgarh's attractive policy. Shah emphasized development initiatives transforming Bastar, promising significant progress in infrastructure and economic opportunities for tribal communities.
title: ‘Maoism never helped any society’: Shah urges Naxalites to surrender

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Microsoft has appointed Charlie Bell, its former security chief, as the company's new engineering quality head — less than a year after CEO Satya Nadella said AI writes 30% of its code. The move comes amid rising Windows 11 bugs, underwhelming Copilot adoption, and growing evidence that AI-generated code introduces more errors than it eliminates.
title: Microsoft appoints its first 'Engineering Quality Head,' and here's why that matters

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: A recent mosque bombing in Islamabad highlights Pakistan's security challenges, even as its generals offer Washington access to vast mineral wealth. Insurgents, armed with US-made weapons left in Afghanistan, threaten critical mining projects in Balochistan, complicating Pakistan's strategic mineral diplomacy and its balancing act between China and the US.
title: Minerals, militants, US-made guns: Why Trump’s bet on Munir is set to fail

author: TOI NEWS DESK
description: Assam Congress chief Gaurav Gogoi has strongly denied allegations made by Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma linking him to Pakistan. Gogoi called the claims false and demanded the immediate release of an SIT report to prove his innocence. He accused the Chief Minister of targeting his family and a community.
title: 'My wife visited Pak for work-related purpose': Gaurav Gogoi on Assam CM's allegations

author: TOI NEWS DESK
description: Veteran leader Sharad Pawar was admitted to a Pune hospital after experiencing a persistent cough and breathing difficulties. Doctors confirmed a chest infection following a CT scan. Accompanied by his daughter Supriya Sule, the 85-year-old leader is under close medical observation, with further treatment decisions pending test results.
title: NCP(SP) chief Sharad Pawar hospitalised in Pune after health concerns

author: JYOTIRMOY HALDER
description: Arshi Gupta, a 9-year-old from Faridabad, became the youngest driver selected for the F1 Academy’s Discover Your Drive (DYD) programme. Noticing her early love for speed, her father guided her into karting, leading to international training and wins in the UAE, UK, and India. Her journey highlights not only her exceptional talent but also India’s limited motorsport infrastructure.
title: No ecosystem in India: How 9-yo Arshi became youngest to join F1 programme

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: European investor Henrick Johansson and Tesla CEO Elon Musk engaged in a public spat on social media. Johansson questioned Musk's wealth and its potential for global good, prompting Musk to label him a 'fool' and criticize EU regulations. Johansson retorted, sarcastically offering Musk a job and suggesting he learn about GDPR, escalating their online exchange.
title: One of Europe’s biggest investors is ‘very angry’ with Musk for calling him ‘fool’

author: AYUSH PANDEY
description: India's ambitious Advanced Medium Combat Aircraft (AMCA) project is reportedly excluding Hindustan Aeronautics Limited from its development phase, signaling a potential shift towards private industry leadership. This move, amid HAL's existing commitments and Tejas Mk-1A delays, aims to accelerate the development of the indigenous fifth-generation stealth fighter.
title: Pvt players or HAL? Who will build India's 5th gen stealth jet AMCA - explained

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Former India batter Aakash Chopra urged the ICC and top nations to offer sustained opportunities to associate teams like Nepal, citing their thrilling T20 World Cup 2026 performance against England. He criticized token participation, emphasizing that genuine growth requires regular bilateral series and tournaments, not just fleeting applause after major events.
title: 'Stop the lip service': Ex-India cricketer's blunt message after Nepal stun the T20 WC

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Zimbabwe dominated Oman in their T20 World Cup match, winning by eight wickets. Fast bowlers Blessing Muzarabani, Richard Ngarava, and Brad Evans dismantled Oman’s batting to limit them to 103 runs. In reply, Brian Bennett’s unbeaten 48 and Brendan Taylor’s 31 guided Zimbabwe to a comfortable chase in just over 13 overs. The win highlighted Zimbabwe’s strong bowling attack and Bennett’s excellent form.
title: T20 WC: Zimbabwe kickstart campaign with dominant win over Oman

author: TOI NEWS DESK
description: The Supreme Court has directed the Delhi High Court to expedite the hearing of former BJP MLA Kuldeep Singh Sengar's plea for bail and suspension of sentence in the Unnao rape victim's father's custodial death case. This comes after the High Court previously denied him bail in the matter, which stems from a 2018 FIR.
title: Unnao rape case: SC rejects Kuldeep Sengar’s bail plea, asks HC for ‘out of turn’ hearing

author: TOI NEWS DESK
description: ​​A bench comprising Justice Aravind Kumar and Justice PB Varale declined to interfere, describing the high court order as balanced. Appearing for the petitioner, Advocate Prashant Bhushan submitted that there has never been a law and order problem in the area. ​​"It seems to be a very very balanced order," Justice Kumar said and Justice Varale agreed with it.
title: 'Very balanced order': SC upholds Madras high court's deepam nod at Madurai hilltop

author: TOI NEWS DESK
description: Armenia has showcased new Indian-made weapons, including Akash missile systems and Pinaka rocket launchers, marking a significant step in its defence ties with New Delhi. This move signifies Armenia's diversification of arms procurement, seeking alternatives to Soviet and Russian equipment. The deal, valued at $250 million, underscores India's growing role as a defence exporter.
title: Watch: Armenia ups defence, shows off Indian Akash SAMs, Pinaka

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: In his grand jury testimony, Nixon described a secret assurance given to Beijing during the war. His full statement reads: “The Russians were supporting India. … Nobody was supporting Pakistan because there was an embargo on the shipment of arms. … But we were giving moral support to them, and also we gave to the Chinese an assurance privately that if India jumped Pakistan and China decided to take on the Indians that we would support them.”
title: Watergate revelations: Nixon asked China to interfere in India-Pak 1971 War

author: SMITA MISHRA
description: India's real estate is booming, with Tier 2 cities emerging as key investment hubs. Driven by improved infrastructure, enhanced liveability, and stable growth, these mid-sized urban centers offer affordable living and rising property values. Developers are increasingly investing here, signaling a shift towards more predictable, end-user-focused markets offering a better quality of life.
title: What are Tier-2 cities and why they’re hotspots for real estate investment

author: TOI NEWS DESK
description: The Supreme Court has stated it will not permit any obstacles in the ongoing special intensive revision of electoral rolls across states. This comes as West Bengal chief minister Mamata Banerjee filed a petition challenging the revision process in her poll-bound state.
title: 'Won't allow any impediment in SIR': SC's clear message to states on Mamata's plea

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Saif Ali Khan and Amrita Singh's inter-faith marriage in 1991 saw Saif respecting Amrita's religious choices, a principle he extended to their children, Sara and Ibrahim. Despite initial concerns post-divorce regarding their upbringing in Amrita's custody, Saif trusted her to maintain their religious balance. The wedding itself was a unique blend of traditions.
title: When Saif Ali Khan said he never forced Amrita Singh to convert to Islam, was concerned about kids

author: VATSAL CHANDRA
description: The Supreme Court pointed out that, although anticipatory bail under Section 438 CrPC is not a fundamental right but a statutory right, the delay in dispensing bail applications by the courts constitutes a direct implication of Article 21.
title: Liberty cannot be kept in limbo: Supreme court fixes timelines for bail applications

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Head coach Gautam Gambhir lauded T20I skipper Suryakumar Yadav for his calm leadership, stating the captain's man-management skills have significantly eased the coaching role. Gambhir highlighted Suryakumar's ability to connect with players and foster a relaxed dressing-room atmosphere, emphasizing his effectiveness under pressure and his crucial role in India's campaign.
title: ‘Ticked every box’: Gautam Gambhir’s bold verdict on Suryakumar Yadav’s captaincy

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Starmer is not accused of misconduct, and Mandelson has consistently denied any impropriety. Yet British politics does not operate solely on legal thresholds. It operates on perception, timing and instinct. The renewed attention on Epstein has revived a broader unease about elite networks, proximity to power and the sense that some figures are insulated from consequences. In that climate, Mandelson’s return has become a liability rather than an asset, raising uncomfortable questions not about guilt, but about judgement.
title: Keir Starmer out, Shabana Mahmood in? How Epstein files could lead to UK's first Muslim PM

author: TOI NEWS DESK
title: 'Act of fear': Women Cong MPs write to LS Speaker Om Birla, reject 'threat' to PM Modi charge

author: YUDHVIR RANA
description: A shocking murder-suicide unfolded at Usma Law College in Tarn Taran, where a first-year student fatally shot her classmate before taking his own life. Both students, Sandeep Kaur and Prince Raj Singh, were in their first semester. Authorities are investigating the motive, reviewing CCTV footage and witness statements to understand the tragic incident that has left the campus reeling.
title: Punjab campus horror: Law student kills girl classmate, then turns gun on himself

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Italy's T20 World Cup debut was marred by captain Wayne Madsen's serious shoulder injury early in their match against Scotland.  While Madsen was sidelined, Scotland's George Munsey smashed 84, guiding them to a formidable 207/4, the tournament's first 200+ score.  The extent of Madsen's injury and his future participation remain uncertain.
title: Big blow for Azzurri: Italy captain injured as T20 World Cup dream turns sour

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Pakistan narrowly escaped defeat against the Netherlands in their T20 World Cup opener, thanks to a late surge from Faheem Ashraf. Despite a disciplined bowling effort, the batting faltered, drawing sharp criticism from former cricketer Basit Ali, who questioned the middle order's temperament and the team's lack of match-winners.  Stronger batting displays are now crucial.
title: 'Chanafali bech rahe the kya?': Ex-Pakistan cricketer's brutal attack on PAK batters

author: HADI KHAN
description: Three minor sisters tragically ended their lives in Ghaziabad, leaping from their ninth-floor apartment. Investigations revealed a complex family dynamic, with the girls deeply engrossed in Korean culture. Their diary entries suggest intense frustration over parental opposition to their interests and a profound sense of isolation, hinting at a desperate cry for understanding.
title: 3 wives, 1 dead live-in partner, 3 dead daughters: Ghaziabad suicide case reveals grim past

author: LACHIT ROY
description: Kim Kardashian and Lewis Hamilton’s recent public appearances have fueled dating rumors and sparked interest in their massive wealth. Kardashian leads financially with an estimated $2 billion net worth driven by Skims. Hamilton, worth about $450 million, earns through racing, endorsements, and investments. Together, their combined net worth exceeds $2.4 billion.
title: Kim Kardashian vs Lewis Hamilton: Who is richer amid dating rumours?

author: TNN
description: A newborn girl tragically perished in a fire that erupted in the NICU of Raja Hospital in Kanpur's Bithoor area. The blaze, reportedly caused by a short circuit, engulfed the infant's bed. Hospital staff allegedly concealed the incident for hours before the distressed parents were informed, leading to a chaotic scene and police intervention.
title: 'Staff kept incident hidden for hrs': Newborn charred to death in Kanpur hospital fire

author: RAUNAK BOSE
description: Trade speculation is intensifying around the Lakers potentially acquiring Giannis Antetokounmpo in the 2026 offseason. A hypothetical framework involves a package of Austin Reaves, Rui Hachimura, Dalton Knecht, Adou Thiero, and multiple future draft picks. This move would create a star-studded trio with LeBron James and Luka Dončić, aiming for immediate championship contention.
title: NBA trade rumors: Lakers eye $186m Bucks star to join LeBron & Doncic

author: MAHIMA ROY
description: As Taylor Swift deals with probably being called to court after her controversial text exchange with Blake Lively was made public, it seems Travis Kelce was never fond of their company. Just a few hours ago, an insider has claimed that Travis Kelce reportedly felt uncomfortable while hanging out with the Hollywood power couple and is now pretty concerned about Taylor Swift.
title: Travis Kelce felt 'awkward' with Blake Lively & Ryan Reynolds, reports say
